name: Wakasa (Fukui, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Wakasa town emblem in green: a stylised device of leaf-like strokes, like a letter W.
history: Municipal flag of Wakasa, a town in Fukui Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 31 March 2005.

features.role: Wakasa town emblem — a stylised device of leaf-like strokes, like a letter W
